name: Lasso test
logline: At the Reston Wranglers ranch at sunset, the three wranglers rope the man in the plaid shirt; he wriggles free, grabs a lasso, and catches his own hat by accident while the women cheer.

Lighting is warm low-angle sunset rim-light with long soft shadows; colour palette is amber, burnt orange, dusty brown and faded denim blue.
